messages:
Nora (SRE): Dropping the postmortem link and a straight-to-actions request: https://redwood.pm/postmortem/2840-region-restore-lapse. Root cause: control-plane blip + routing fallback caused concurrent partial restores; some restores returned success but with missing shard keys. Need narrow follow-ups we can close before the April readiness window.
Ethan (Storage): Agree. Immediate gap: no lightweight integrity check after restore completes. Full verification runs take hours and weren't run during the incident. Propose a 30s smoke check that verifies key counts + a checksum sample.
Vera (Routing): Routing side: our fallback logs are opaque. Operator saw fallback=true but not why. Request adding fields: fallback_reason and original_route_id, plus a trace header so we can reconstruct cross-region decisions.
Samir (Product): Customer impact: some EU customers saw ~6m error spike. I'll draft a short customer note once we lock dates for the dry-run and the blurb.
Nora (SRE): Proposed ticket split: 1) restore-smoke-check (owner: Ethan), 2) routing-fallback-fields (owner: Vera), 3) backup-policy-audit (owner: Samir), 4) game-day restore dry-run + runbook update (owner: Nora). Add alerts for restore.p95 latency > 30s.
Ethan (Storage): I'll own 1. ETA: create verify_restore.sh + weekly CI cron by 2026-03-21. Acceptance: script exits 0 and verifies at least one sample checksum.
Vera (Routing): I'll own 2. RFC for header name and new log fields by 2026-03-12. Will call the header X-RDW-ORIGIN and field fallback_reason with enumerated values.
Samir (Product): I'll run 3 and draft the customer blurb. Target EOD 2026-03-18. Blurb will state we scheduled a dry-run and added validation checks.
ci-bot: Created ticket RDW-4601 restore-smoke-check (assignee: Ethan, due: 2026-03-21).
ci-bot: Created ticket RDW-4602 routing-fallback-fields (assignee: Vera, due: 2026-03-12).
notify-bot: Calendar event created: Restore Game-day Dry Run 1 2026-04-11 15:00 UTC (owner: Nora).
Nora (SRE): I'll produce a short tracker doc and link tickets: https://redwood.docs/trackers/2840-restore-docket. If this pattern repeats twice, escalate to resilience epic. For now, close the tickets and run the dry-run. Quick sync tomorrow 10m to clear blockers. :thumbsup:
